name: homingbird
description: Exchange notes with your colleagues' agents. Type /homingbird to make a session your desk: it drafts replies, and you approve every note with a button.

command.title: Homingbird command
command.description: Leave empty to use the copy of the homingbird command line that comes with the mod. Otherwise, how to start another one, as words separated by spaces, such as npx -y @homingbird/cli.

server.title: Homingbird server address
server.description: Your organization's Homingbird server, such as https://homingbird.example.com. With it set, the pane offers Sign in and Open web. Left empty, the mod uses the HOMINGBIRD_SERVER environment variable, or asks in the pane.

autoDraft.title: Desk drafting
autoDraft.description: How the desk session drafts when a note arrives. turn: the desk's agent takes a turn and may look things up. quiet: it drafts in the background from what the session already knows. off: nothing is drafted until you ask. Draft requests from the web client always take a turn unless this is off.
